Key data-testid attributes: smart-improve-summary-btn, ai-improve-summary-btn, ai-remaining-summary, smart-summary-suggestions, smart-improve-bullet-{idx}, ai-improve-bullet-{idx}, smart-bullet-suggestions-{idx}, email-smart-generate-btn, email-ai-generate-btn, email-ai-remaining.
